item.title: Resource Lifecycle & Retention Runbook
item.description:
Cleanup AWS CloudFormation Amazon Quick

This chapter is intentionally a runbook. Teardown is the one part of the project where operation order matters more than narrative: deleting a source before its consumers are inventoried can destroy evidence, while leaving temporary capacity behind creates ongoing cost.

Inventory and ownership decision
→ advanced AI assets
→ custom BI assets
→ CUDOS assets
→ anomaly routing
→ Data Export and collection stack
→ delayed billing verification

item.title: Lifecycle Verification & Residual Cost Check
item.description:
Validation Cleanup FinOps

Deletion commands are not proof of lifecycle completion. The final state is reconciled across control planes and revisited after billing data has caught up.

Verify CloudFormation

Confirm the project Data Exports stack is no longer active.

Verify Data Exports

Confirm the project export is gone if you intended to remove it.

Verify S3 and Glue

Check that project-owned S3 and Glue resources are removed or intentionally retained.
